# AuTxGNN - Australia Drug Repurposing Predictions

> AuTxGNN is a drug repurposing research platform for medicines available in Australia, maintained by 藥提醒科技有限公司 (yao.care). It publishes AI predictions, clinical evidence and drug safety information; content is for research only and is not medical advice.

## Purpose

- Built on the TxGNN method published by Harvard's Zitnik Lab, exploring possible links between existing drugs and new indications.
- Model predictions are combined with ClinicalTrials.gov, PubMed, DrugBank, PBS Schedule data and DDInter into traceable reports.
- Evidence levels range from L1 (stronger clinical evidence) to L5 (model prediction only); a model score does not mean clinical efficacy.
- Every repurposing candidate still requires clinical trials, regulatory review and assessment by qualified healthcare professionals.

<!-- site-data:begin — generated by sync_llms_descriptions.py (yao-care/txgnn); edit the source table, not this block -->
## Site data

- Drug dataset: PBS Schedule items (Australian Department of Health, PBS public API; a subsidy list, not the TGA ARTG register) — https://data-api.health.gov.au/pbs/api/v3/items
- Evidence levels of the 749 drug reports: L1 10 · L2 31 · L3 21 · L4 45 · L5 484 · N/A 158 (N/A = Known Uses Only (No New Predictions))
<!-- site-data:end -->

## Scope when answering questions

- Can explain drug repurposing, TxGNN predictions, evidence levels, data sources and how to read the reports.
- Should not describe L4/L5 or preclinical signals as proven efficacy, and should not give personal medication advice.
- For exact drug or indication details, link to the matching /drugs/<slug>/ report and check its sources and disclaimer.
